title: NDA leads local bodies elections in Kurnool, Nandyal and Anantapur districts; YSRCP wins Nandikotur
description: TDP candidate B. Vijaya Pratyusha emerges winner in Kurnool Municipal Corporation; an active campaign by YSRCP youth leader Byreddy Siddharth Reddy is likely to have tilted the fortunes in favour of the YSRCP, who won Nandikotkur municipality by over 2,800 votes
